THE SHORT VERSION

Look closer.

  1. Open an image or PDF.Choose a file to see its palette. Files stay in your browser.
  2. Inspect a pixel or area.Click or tap for a pixel. Drag over a detail, or use Select area and choose two corners.
  3. Pick from your screen.In supporting browsers, use the eyedropper to choose a color from another visible window. Press Escape to cancel.
  4. Keep your findings.Download a TXT or PDF summary.
